description: Trinkwasser Versorgungszonen Tirol is a dataset listed in opendataportal.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by data-tiris.opendata.arcgis.com. The drinking water supply zones indicate relatively precisely the individual zones of a water supply system. Within a zone, there are mainly uniform conditions. The different zones are assigned to the entire plant for larger water supply installations. Coverage: AT. The portal shows the English title as "Drinking water supply zones Tyrol" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include tiris, tirol, wasserzone, binnengewässer, geodaten, umwelt. The listing shows 3 download or service links in HTML, PDF, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.de). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-portal-austria.
